Padhne wala edition (Hinglish)

AI From Zero

Pune ki ek chhoti si team ne ek privacy guard banaya, aur seekha ki AI products asal mein kaise bante hain

Yeh kitaab padhne ke liye hai, course karne ke liye nahi. Wahi ideas, wahi kram, wahi shabd jo course app mein hain, bas ek lambi kahani ki tarah.

Padhna shuru kariyeWahin se jaari rakhiye

47 chapterlagbhag 89 hazaar shabd236 shabd samjhaaye gaye

Vishay-soochi

  1. Shuru karne se pehleYeh kitaab kya hai, ismein kaun-kaun milenge, aur ise kaise padhna hai.
1

Woh problem jo hal karne layak hai

Anaya ko chat mein kuch ajeeb dikhta hai, aur woh seekhti hai ki product wala insaan kaise tay karta hai ki kya banana hai aur kya chhod dena hai.

  1. 1Chat Mein Woh NumberEk product manager ek hafte ki customer chats padhti hai, usmein woh cheez dhoondh leti hai jise woh dhoondh hi nahi rahi thi, aur use tay karna hai ki kya yeh cheez uski ek saal ki mehnat ke laayak hai.10 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 2Banane Se Pehle Chaar SawaalEk engineer woh sawaal poochta hai jisse har idea ko guzarna chahiye, aur ek aisa feature jise kisi ne dekha hi nahi, team ko sikhata hai ki products asal mein kahan fail hote hain.10 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 3Kal Ke Baare Mein PoochhnaPaanch baatcheet ek product manager ko sikhati hain ki kaam ka sawaal kabhi "kya aapko yeh pasand aayega?" nahi hota, aur ki problem utni wahan nahi thi jahan woh soch rahi thi.11 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 4Yahan Aur Kaun Khada HaiCompliance head ek shart ke saath haan kehti hai, aur ek product manager seekhti hai ki market ka size neeche se upar kaise naapte hain, aur jo competition dikhta nahi use utni hi gambhirta se kaise lete hain jitni usse jo dikhta hai.9 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 5Kya Nahi Karna Hai, Yeh ChunnaEk Sunday ki call par ek retired teacher woh sawaal poochhti hain jo achhe ideas ke dher ko strategy mein badal deta hai, aur product ko apna naam mil jaata hai.9 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 6Aisa Plan Jis Par Doosre Bharosa KareinStrategy tab tak sirf ek vaakya hai jab tak doosre log us par amal na kar sakein. Anaya dates ki jagah nateejon ka waada karna seekhti hai, un logon ki list banana jo na keh sakte hain, aur project ko pehle se mara hua kalpana mein dekhna.9 min padhai✓ padha
  7. 7Likh Kar Rakhna Taaki Doosre Bana SakeinEk engineer guard ko napkin par banata hai, ek product manager use aisi specification mein badalti hai jisse ek ajnabi bana sake, aur ek support agent dikhata hai ki kaagaz ka mock-up woh dhoondh leta hai jo meeting nahi dhoondh paati.9 min padhai✓ padha
2

Machine se mulaqaat

Language model kya hai, usse baat kaise karte hain, aur kaise pata chalta hai ki usne achha kaam kiya ya nahi.

  1. 8Machine Asal Mein Kya HaiEk Sunday ki call par ek product manager maan leti hai ki use nahi pata "powered by AI" ka matlab kya hai, aur ek retired linguist aur ek engineer milkar jawaab banate hain, ek-ek saral idea ke saath.9 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 9Pehli BaatcheetEk engineer product manager ko dikhata hai ki ek message model tak jaata hai aur wapas aata hai, aur receipt par jo dikhta hai woh utna hi zaroori hai jitna jawaab mein jo padha jaata hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 10Ek Dimaag Jise Kuch Yaad Nahi RehtaEk mithai ki dukaan ka maalik, jise har regular yaad hai, ek product manager ko sikhata hai ki chatbot ko yaad kyun nahi rehta, aur is farak se uske bill aur uski problem par kya asar padta hai.6 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 11Nirdesh DenaTeam pehli baar model se guard ka kaam karne ko kehti hai, use teen alag tareeko se galat hote dekhti hai, aur seekhti hai ki failure ko kam baar hona banana aur uski wajah ko hata dena, dono mein kya farak hai.9 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 12Kaise Pata Chale Ki Yeh Kaam Karta HaiTeam yeh dekhna chhod deti hai ki jawaab kaisa lagta hai, tool ke jawaab dekhne se pehle sahi jawaab likh leti hai, aur paati hai ki jo version sabko pasand tha woh sabse achha nahi tha.8 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 13Chhaantna Aur Saar LikhnaEk kaam jiska sahi jawaab hai aur ek jiska nahi. Team ek sorter ko naapti hai, woh failure dhoondhti hai jise uska ek akela score chhupa raha tha, aur phir ek saar mein jaanchti hai ki usne kya chhod diya.7 min padhai✓ padha
3

Cheezein dhoondhna, aur poori machine

Lambe documents, shabdon se aur matlab se search, aur kaise saare hisse milkar ek chalta hua system banate hain.

  1. 14Ek Baar Mein Padhne Ke Liye Bahut LambaYeh samajhne ke liye ki chatbot Sahaj ke apne documents se sawaalon ke jawaab kaise deta hai, ek product manager ek policy ko kainchi se teen baar tukdon mein kaatti hai, aur seekhti hai ki kaatne ka koi tareeka sahi nahi hota.7 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 15Shabdon Se DhoondhnaEk product manager search box ka kirdaar nibhati hai, seekhti hai ki cheezein dhoondhne ka sabse purana tareeka un customers ko kyun fail karta hai jinhe madad ki sabse zyada zaroorat hai, aur woh ek pehchaan ke number ke liye bilkul sahi kyun hai.6 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 16Matlab Se DhoondhnaEk bazaar jahan ek hi vyapar ki dukaanein ek hi gali mein hoti hain, ek product manager ko woh tasveer deta hai jo use us idea ke liye chahiye jisne search ko bachaya, aur ek aisa number jis par shak karna chahiye.8 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 17Kitna Achha, Achha Hota HaiKoi senior woh sawaal poochhta hai jisse har AI project ko kabhi na kabhi guzarna padta hai. Jawaab do numbers hain, unke beech ek chunav jo engineer ka nahi hai, aur ek aisa figure jise Anaya ne bina jaanche quote kiya tha uspar ek asuvidhajanak nazar.8 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 18Poori MachineAb har hissa haath se banaya aur toda ja chuka hai, isliye poora chatbot yaad se draw kiya ja sakta hai, naam diya ja sakta hai, aur laal pen wali ek compliance head us par chal sakti hai jo jaanna chahti hai ki har shabd kahan jaata hai.7 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 19Aise Jawaab Jo Program Istemaal Kar SakeEk paragraph insaan ke liye theek hai aur program ke liye bekaar. Team seekhti hai ki "JSON mein jawaab do, please" kaafi kyun nahi hai, aur ek form ko itna achha kaise banayein ki model ke paas gadhne ki jagah hi na rahe.7 min padhai✓ padha
4

Machine ko kaam dena

Tools, sochne wale models, dushman text, hazaaron jawaabon ki grading, aur sab kuch kitne mein padta hai.

  1. 20Machine Ko Haath DenaBarah ank ka order number bilkul Aadhaar number jaisa dikhta hai, aur dono mein farak batane ka ek hi tareeka hai: use dhoondh kar dekhna. Model ko dhoondhne dene se team seekhti hai ki loop kya hota hai, uska kharcha kitna hai, aur uske kaun se kaam mein insaan chahiye.8 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 21Lambi Windows, Saavdhaan KamreEk salesman elaan karta hai ki bahut badi context window is sab mehnat ko gair-zaroori bana deti hai, aur ek product manager use woh ek sawaal poochhti hai jo meeting khatam kar deta hai. Kamre mein kya jaata hai woh us se zyada maayne rakhta hai ki kamra kitna bada hai.7 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 22Pehle Sochne Wali MachinesJo model jawaab dene se pehle use soch kar nikalta hai woh mushkil cases sahi karta hai aur ismein gyarah second lagta hai. Lonavala ke paas ruki ek train aur intezaar na kar sakne wali chat window ke beech, team seekhti hai ki sochna kab kharidne layak hai aur intezaar ko jhelne layak kaise banayein.8 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 23Behtar SearchEk customer ko pichhle saal ki late fee batayi jaati hai, aur search ke chaar sudhaar, jinhe ek hi answer key se naapa gaya, dikhate hain ki sabse feeka sudhaar hi akela hai jo kuch waada kar sakta hai.7 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 24Jab Page Hukm Dene Lagta HaiGuard isliye hai ki woh ajnabiyon ka likha padhe, jo use building ka sabse khula hua program banata hai. Team apna dasva vaakya test karti hai, ek model ko ek ajnabi ki baat maante dekhti hai, aur seekhti hai ki jo raksha sambhavna ghatati hai aur jo kisi taqat ko hata deti hai, unme kya farak hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 25Hazaar Jawaabon Ki GradingHaath se jaanchna lagbhag pachaas jawaabon par kaam karna band kar deta hai. Team marking par ek machine lagati hai, bharose se pehle marker ko jaanchti hai, aur phir woh kaam karti hai jo is kshetra mein sabse zyada kaam ka hai aur jisme kisi machine ki zaroorat nahi.8 min padhai✓ padha
  7. 26Asal Mein Kitna Kharcha Hota HaiFinance director ko "yeh tokens par nirbhar karta hai" jawaab nahi hai. Ek product manager guard ki sahi keemat nikaalti hai, ek hi tool ke teen bahut alag kul paati hai, aur dekhti hai ki uske chaar dibbon ke chalne ka kram sabse sasta design faisla kyun hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
5

Asli duniya ki uljhanein

Scans aur photos, kya bhejna theek hai, niyam, badalte rehne wali cheez ki spec, aur galat jawaab ke liye design.

  1. 27Kaagaz, Photos Aur ScansAb tak guard ne jo bhi vaakya padha woh pehle se text tha. Pachaas attachments ka ek random namoona dikhata hai ki asli zindagi mein yeh kitna kam sach hai, aur kaise ek bada O jo zero bana hua hai ek number ko seedhe ek rule ke paas se nikaal sakta hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 28Aap Kya Bhej Sakte HainAb tak sab kuch maan kar chala ki text bheja ja sakta hai. Lakshmi mez par teen documents rakhti hai, ek tay kram mein teen sawaal poochhti hai, aur ek vendor ki terms of service mein aisi baatein nikalti hain jo kisi ne padhi nahi thin.8 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 29Niyam, Risk Aur ZimmedaariLakshmi batati hai ki bank mein bees saal ne use kaagazi kaam ke baare mein kya sikhaya, aur team woh ek-page ka document likhti hai jo kehta hai ki guard kis liye hai, woh kya galat karta hai, aur use kis kaam ke liye kabhi istemaal nahi karna chahiye. Phir woh ek customer ko delete karne ki koshish karte hain, aur dhoondhte hain ki woh kahan rehta hai.10 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 30Badalti Rehne Wali Cheez Ki SpecEk model ke retire hone ka tees din ka notice dikhata hai ki jo software do baar ek jaisa behave nahi karta uski specification mein asal mein kya hona chahiye, aur AI ko band karne ka switch kya chalta chhodna chahiye.8 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 31Banao, Kharido Ya SikhaoEk vendor team ko woh bechne ki peshkash karta hai jo team ne chhe mahine mein khud banaya, aur ek founder unka apna model banane ki peshkash karta hai. Dono prastaav samajhdaar lagte hain, aur dono ko ek hi test se guzarna hai.9 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 32Galat Jawaab Ke Liye DesignNabbe percent par, das mein se ek jawaab galat hota hai, aur us ek par screen jo karti hai wahi tay karta hai ki tool par bharosa kiya jaata hai ya nahi. Phir ek pilot, jo fail hone ke liye design kiya gaya tha, kuch ajeeb karta hai: woh safal hota hai, aur kuch nahi badalta.9 min padhai✓ padha
6

Bonnet ke neeche

Plumbing, model chunna, review mein tikne wala retrieval, agents, awaaz aur tasveerein, release gates, aur sabse bura maan kar chalna.

  1. 33Jaadu Ke Neeche Ki PlumbingDo ghante ka ek outage jisme kisi ne error nahi uthaya, ek product manager ko manata hai ki use us aam software ko, ek plumber ke diagram ke star par, samajhna chahiye jo us ek anishchit hisse ke aas-paas hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 34Apne Cases Par Model ChunnaEk founder us model par switch karna chahta hai jo pichhle hafte ke chart mein sabse upar tha. Team wahi karti hai jo aap gaadi ke saath karte hain, teen ko apni sadkon par chalakar dekhti hai, aur phir kehna seekhti hai ki har model jis kamre mein jaata hai usme theek-theek kya hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 35Review Mein Tikne Wala RetrievalEk prototype isliye kaam karta hai ki aapne har document chuna hai aur aap akele user hain. Production dono sukh chheen leta hai. Har retrieval system par laagu hone wale chaar sawaal chatbot se un logon ke kamre mein poochhe jaate hain jo chahte hain ki woh fail ho.9 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 36Workflows, Agents Aur Standard PlugEk bank teller aapka balance dekh sakta hai lekin aapke kehne par aapka paisa kahin bhej nahi sakta. Support console ke baare mein teen sawaal, model ko kitna tay karne dein, use kaise rokein, aur ek standard plug kya waada karta hai aur kya nahi, kuch cheezein kaat kar tay kiye jaate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 37Pages, Tasveerein Aur AwaazeinEk rail ke timetable ko shabd-dar-shabd zor se padhiye aur kisi ko pata nahi chalta ki train kab jaati hai. Team aakhirkaar photographs aur voice notes lene lagti hai, woh charan dhoondhti hai jahan matlab pehli baar bigadta hai, aur ek aisa test banati hai jo sunne ki galti ko sochne ki galti se alag bata sake.8 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 38Gates, Traces Aur RollbacksEk instruction mein ek Friday raat bina test ke kiya gaya ek edit dikhata hai ki jo badlaav deployment jaisa nahi lagta use gate se guzarna kyun zaroori hai; aur baad mein, aapko "usne aisa kyun kiya?" ka jawaab chaalees second mein dena kyun aana chahiye.8 min padhai✓ padha
  7. 39Sabse Bure Ko Maan Kar ChalnaEk compliance report, ek Saturday jo mithai ko inaam banakar ise todne ki koshish mein bita, aur ek table jisme har suraksha uss test ke bagal mein baithti hai jo use saabit karta hai. Model ke saath chhedchhad hogi; uske aas-paas ki har cheez raksha hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
7

Ek asli product, aur ek naukri

Product ko ship karna, uski keemat tay karna, usse badhana, gina-na, asli users ke saath chalana, aur is kaam ke liye naukri paana.

  1. 40Product, Demo NahiEk dish jo aap do logon ke liye achhe se banate hain, restaurant ke menu ka item nahi hoti. Tyohar ke season se pehle, team har woh cheez likhti hai jo ek kaam karte prototype aur ek service ke beech khadi hai, aur har bade faisle ke liye likhti hai ki use palatne ke liye kya chahiye.8 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 41Poori Cheez Ko Ship KarnaDecember mein, Anaya un logon ke saamne khadi hoti hai jinhone idea par sandeh kiya tha aur batati hai ki usne kya banaya, kya toota, kisne istemaal kiya, kitna kharcha aaya, aur use kya nahi pata. Jin gyarah charno ko usne follow kiya woh woh saal hai jo usne abhi jiya hai, naam ke saath.9 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 42Paisa Kaun Deta Hai, Aur KitnaEk lender ka technical lead poochhta hai ki guard use kitne mein padega, aur ek product manager paati hai ki jawaab teen alag logon, paisa lene ke chaar tareeko, aur ek table ki ek row par nirbhar karta hai jo zyadatar price lists mein banti hi nahi.9 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 43Log Ise Kaise Dhoondhte Hain Aur Kyun Rukte HainJo tool kisi ko mile hi nahi woh kisi ki raksha nahi karta. Paanch developers ko ek README thama diya jaata hai aur kuch nahi, ek stopwatch record karta hai ki woh kahan chhod dete hain, aur ek spelling checker ek product manager ko sikhata hai ki value ka pehla pal kahan hona chahiye.8 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 44Jo Maayne Rakhta Hai Use GinnaJab asli log product istemaal karte hain, sawaal "kya yeh kaam karta hai?" se badal kar "woh kya karte hain?" ho jaata hai, aur ek privacy product ko iska jawaab bina ek bhi woh cheez record kiye dena hota hai jo use chhupani hai. Phir ek sample-size ka jod samjhata hai ki ek jawan company woh test kyun nahi chala sakti jo woh chahti hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 45Tools Aur HarnessEk naya engineer poochhta hai ki kaun sa tool kis kaam ka hai, aur ek purana engineer brands ki list ki jagah slots ka ek drawing banakar jawaab deta hai. Phir wahi engineer ek saptahik report do baar banane ke liye diya jaata hai, ek baar tay charno ke saath aur ek baar agent ke saath, aur dono ko usi bees hafton par naapa jaata hai.13 min padhai✓ padha
  7. 46Asli Log, Asli IstemaalEk demonstration tab kaam karta hai jab aap use dekh rahe hote hain. Ek product ko tab kaam karna hota hai jab koi nahi dekh raha, un logon ke liye jo aapke kuch nahi lagte. Vasant mein Anaya guard ko ajnabiyon ke liye taiyaar karti hai, unhe imaandari se jodti hai, unke istemaal ke dauran haath baandhe baithi rehti hai, aur jo usne dekha uske kaaran ek badlaav ship karti hai.10 min padhai✓ padha
  8. 47Kaam, Aur NaukriEk purani bank analyst ne kuch asli banaya hai aur use pata nahi ki ise dikhaye kaise. Kuch Sunday shaamon mein Anaya uski madad karti hai ki ek saal ka kaam un naukriyon ki tasveer mein badal jaye jo woh chahti hai, saboot ka ek page, aur un sawaalon ka ek abhyaas kiya hua jawaab dene ka tareeka jo tay karte hain ki use woh milti hain ya nahi.10 min padhai✓ padha
